calc_items.title: Pre/postductal SpO₂ difference
calc_items.question: Preductal SpO₂ is 91% and postductal SpO₂ is 86%. Calculate the absolute percentage-point difference.

calc_items.title: F-100 catch-up intake (Day 14 retest)
calc_items.question: A 9-kg child has an ordered catch-up intake of 150 kcal/kg/day. At 1 kcal/mL of F-100, calculate the kcal/day and the corresponding feed volume.
calc_items.working: 9 × 150 = 1350 kcal/day; at 1 kcal/mL = 1350 mL/day. A mathematical scenario, not an individual feeding prescription.

calc_items.title: 10% dextrose volume and glucose (Day 14 retest)
calc_items.question: A protocol explicitly orders 2 mL/kg of 10% dextrose for a 4.5-kg child. Calculate the volume and the glucose mass.
calc_items.working: 2 × 4.5 = 9 mL; 10% = 0.1 g/mL, so 9 × 0.1 = 0.9 g glucose. Check the dose against the local SAM protocol before clinical use.

calc_items.title: Rehabilitation energy (Day 14 retest)
calc_items.question: 180 kcal/kg/day is prescribed for an 11-kg child. Calculate the kcal/day and the equivalent F-100 volume at 1 kcal/mL.
calc_items.working: 11 × 180 = 1980 kcal/day; at 1 kcal/mL = 1980 mL/day. Not a recommended feeding prescription.
